why: Handbags (nylon totes from about $158), wallets, shoes, jewellery, clothing and home goods, sold through its own stores, its website and department stores.

doors.note: 181 store pages: 165 US incl. 1 Puerto Rico (outlet), 16 Canada. US = 35 full-price + 130 outlet, using the locator's own label on each page ("Outlet" / "full price"). Fashion District of Philadelphia is labelled Outlet. One outlet (Tulsa) has no phone. No department-store concessions listed.

fibre.sample: full census, not a sample: Clothing view-all shows 144 products; loaded to the end by scrolling, 111 style numbers (colour suffix stripped), 38 swim, sleepwear

craft_evidence.owned: no — none stated; the US store has no about page (/about-us, /our-story 410 Gone)
craft_evidence.heritage: NC — no brand-history page on the US store; the footer links only to Tapestry's supply-chain statement
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every page says only 'Imported'; no maker, mill, facility or process is named, and the store has no brand-history page.
